newsitem.title: UK: UK shares marked lower at outset, hit by ex-divs.
newsitem.headline: UK shares marked lower at outset, hit by ex-divs.

text.p: UK shares were lower at Monday's opening but the fall largely reflected a batch of ex-dividends and the market was seen little moved by news that Prime Minister John Major is likely to confirm a May 1 election.
The FTSE 100 index was down 17.6 points at 4,406.7 by 0839 GMT, but that was mainly due to the impact of shares such as Glaxo Wellcome , HSBC and B.A.T Industries going ex-dividend.
With gilts ticking higher on the back of firm German bunds, dealers said the news that the Government was likely to confirm an election date at least removed one element of uncertainty.
